briefs: docs/round10/track-m2.md (read M20 and docs/round10/track-d0.md D0-2 and D0-3 first)
notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: D0 (shared mob registry), D (trial spawners, vaults, lodestones, breezes), W (darkness, vibrations, sculk, warden), E1 and E2 (known limits), F (Elden Ring boss) and the mob tracks M1 (land animals), M2 (this run: water mobs and buckets) and M3 (night, built mobs and horses), which all plug into D0's registry. Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL, even where a brief says to: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new enum variants, match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small. Record decisions in the track log. M2 edits only its own water group files (entities world/families/water*, world natural_spawner/families/water.rs, terrain families/water*) and the M2 section of docs/round10/mobs.md, plus the shared lines its brief names; every shared piece has one owner in the brief's M20 tables, so never build a copy of an M1, M3, E or W piece: if a group's M20 wait is not met in this branch, leave that group, note it in the log, and go on with the groups that do not need it. RESTARTS: if this run was started again after a stop (the PC crashed on 2026-10-28 at 20:27 with six tracks building), the worktree may hold the current group's half-done work as uncommitted or staged changes: read `git status` and `git diff` (and `git diff --cached`) first, keep what is correct, finish the group and commit it; discard only what is broken. If cargo reports invalid or corrupt metadata, a truncated .rlib/.rmeta or a link error on a file that should exist, run `& .\scripts\cargo-slot.ps1 +target=<this track's target> clean -p <crate>` for that crate and build again. LOAD: builds now run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process.

groups.prompt: Track M2 group water-hooks (segment m2a, after D0's d0a is merged): build docs/round10/track-m2.md section M2-1, its root hooks (read M20 first). Two commits: 'Registered Minecraft mobs breathe like vanilla water animals' (Family::breath with Breath::Lungs { max, refill }, Gills and Own; living::breathe_up_to beside breathe, which breathe calls; the WaterAnimal air rule with 2 minecraft:drown damage; the #[cfg(test)] probe minecraft:swim_probe on key 79) and 'Registered Minecraft mobs make their own swim and step sounds' (Family::swim_sounds, where an empty swim sound means none, and Family::quiet_steps, read by D0's movement_sounds; the one zero-volume guard at emissions.rs:64). family_goal_step_with and Family::ambient are M1's: do not add them. Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m2-log.md and the M2 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md

Track M2 group water-paths (segment m2a): build docs/round10/track-m2.md section M2-1, its paths. Two commits: 'Minecraft path search takes any node evaluator' (a pure refactor of the walk_path.rs A* loop over a private NodeSource, with the walk tests and bin/check_* fixtures unchanged; skip it only if d0b already split walk_path.rs) and 'Minecraft mobs find paths through water like vanilla swimmers and amphibians' (SwimEvaluator with breaching, WalkProfile.amphibious and the AmphibiousNodeEvaluator branches in walk_path.rs, WaterNav { Ground, Bound, Amphibious } after wall_climber and tick_water after tick_amphibious in navigation.rs, water_bound_random_position with an optional home in stroll.rs). M2 owns these; M1's turtles reuse them. Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m2-log.md and the M2 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md

Track M2 group water-buckets (segment m2a): build docs/round10/track-m2.md section M2-1, its mob buckets. Three commits: 'Minecraft mob buckets pour their water and let out the mob they hold' (terrain families/water/buckets.rs with bucket_use and the seven BUCKETS rows; Change::MobBucket, the actions.rs arm, Entities::empty_mob_bucket, Command::EmptyMobBucket and the world's level/mob_bucket.rs Level::empty_mob_bucket, which pours, summons with FromBucket and keeps an unsimulated kind dormant), 'Minecraft fish buckets carry the mob they caught like vanilla' (Bucketable with PICKUP_ITEM defaulting to minecraft:water_bucket and pickup::<S>; its tests give D0's Silverfish a cfg(test) Bucketable impl, since no water family is registered in terrain yet) and 'Dispensers empty fish buckets like vanilla' (one arm after the water_bucket and lava_bucket arm in dispenser.rs for the six water mob buckets; OTHER_BEHAVIOURS stays untouched). No protocol change. Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m2-log.md and the M2 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md

Track M2 group squids-live (segment m2a): build docs/round10/track-m2.md section M2-2. Three commits: 'Registered Minecraft mobs can move by their own rules while dying' (Family::OWN_DYING_TRAVEL), 'Minecraft squids swim in pulses, squirt ink and flee in the entity world' (family squids, key 64, both kinds in one store; Body::move_self split out of travel_air_flying; Breath::Gills; D0's Family::emits_sounds false for vanilla's EVENTS emission if the merged d0a has it, else quiet_steps and an empty swim sound; the random and flee goals; the ink counter and the glow squid's dark ticks) and 'Minecraft squids spawn in oceans and rivers, and glow squids in dark water underground' (the two rows, the shared surface_water_animal rule, dark_deep_water, and the InWater line at natural_spawner.rs:822 that every M2 water row needs). No terrain registration yet. Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m2-log.md and the M2 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md

Track M2 group squids-drawn (segment m2a): build docs/round10/track-m2.md section M2-2. Three commits: 'Registered Minecraft mobs can have a tracking range per kind' (TerrainFamily::tracking_range(kind)), 'Minecraft squids and glow squids are saved, hatch from eggs and are drawn like vanilla' (TerrainFamily, adult and baby models in out.culled, the host-computed tentacle, tilt and roll in FamilyShow, the glow squid's light, the golden dandelion) and 'Minecraft squids leave ink clouds and glow squids sparkle, for friends too' (SquidInk, GlowSquidInk and Glow after Flame in ambient_particles.rs with their own arms, the ink's fade and sink in its own tick arm after Flame and never inside coast's match, client_effects from the squirt counter). Tests, owner's steps and kit as listed; update docs/round10/track-m2-log.md and the M2 rows of docs/round10/mobs.md
